busy.heading: Another link is waiting
busy.message: Watchtower is already asking you to confirm a company link. Answer it there, then open this link again.

newer.heading: This link needs a newer Watchtower
newer.message: Update Watchtower from its menu, then open the link again.

open.heading: Continue in Watchtower
open.message_acme: Watchtower is asking you to confirm Acme. You can close this tab.

refused.heading: This link does not work
refused.hint: Ask your admin for a fresh link, or paste the connect code in Watchtower → Connections.

reasons.damaged: The link is damaged or cut short.
reasons.personal: The link carries a personal Google project, which only this Mac can set.
reasons.site_not_https: The link names a site that is not https.
reasons.too_long: The link is too long to be a Watchtower company link.
